mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness indicated by unemployment rate below 4.0% signals potential inflationary pressures and imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 480000) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST>1200 and RSAFS>480000 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105), supply-side expansion supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and GDP (GDPC1 > 17000) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO>105 and GDPC1>17000 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST > 1200), strong residential construction activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.
